title: Clear a fruit-cutting spot: apple to the bowl, towels away, and the hidden knife onto the plate pointing away, without going near a full mug of coffee
instruction: Someone cut fruit on the table and left it like this. Put the apple in the bowl, then clear the paper towels away; the knife is under them. Lay the knife on the plate with the handle toward you and the blade pointing away. Don't drop anything. The mug is full of hot coffee, so don't spill it and keep the knife well away from it.
context: Paper towels often end up hiding a knife on a kitchen counter. The robot has to infer the hidden blade, uncover it in an order that does not drop the apple, set the knife down blade-away, and carry it clear of an open, full drink.
setup: World frame in mm: x forward of the arm bases, y left (+) or right (-) of the point midway between them (robot's view); heights above the table top. Arm bases at x 0, y +305 and -305. (1) Kitchen knife, loose: an Arena object-library knife model scaled to 170 mm long, 40 g, lying flat on the table along y centred (260, 0), handle toward -y, tip toward +y. (2) Folded paper-towel pad, loose: white paper, 120 (x) x 110 (y) x 8, 3 g, centred (260, 60), lying on the blade. (3) Paper-towel sheet, loose: white paper, 260 (x) x 240 (y) x 1.5, 4 g, centred (260, 0) on the pad and knife, covering the whole knife; it hangs clear of the table on every side. Paper is modelled as rigid thin plates. (4) Apple, loose: red sphere, 66 diameter, 120 g, on the sheet centred (260, 60). (5) Bowl, fixed: the YCB bowl (bowl_ycb_robolab), 160 wide, white, centred (240, 260). (6) Plate, fixed: plate_small_vomp_robolab scaled to 200 wide, white, centred (260, -300). (7) Mug, loose: white ceramic cylinder, 85 diameter, 95 tall, full of coffee (liquid not simulated; 380 g in total), centred (360, -160). The straight carry from the knife to the plate passes within 72.5 mm of the mug's axis. Free table space for the towels: left of centre, in front of the knife (x above 350) and near the robot (x below 160). Fixed layout, no jitter.
scoring: Judged on object poses only. Apple in bowl: apple centre within 40 mm horizontally of the bowl's centre and at most 60 mm above the table, at rest; it does not count if the apple ever touched the table top outside the bowl. Towels cleared: each towel has moved at least 100 mm, lies within 30 mm of the table top, and overlaps neither the knife nor the plate, and neither is in the bowl or on the mug. Knife on plate: knife centre over the plate and its lowest point between the plate's top and 20 mm above it. Knife set: knife on plate, both ends over the plate, lying within 10 degrees of flat, tip pointing within 25 degrees of straight away from the robot (+x). Tiers (end state, highest met): 1.00 apple in bowl, towels cleared, knife set, apple, knife, mug and towels at rest for 1 s; 0.75 apple, towels and knife on the plate but not set or not at rest; 0.50 apple and towels; 0.25 apple only; else 0. Cap 0.50 (any moment): any point of the knife, while its lowest point is more than 15 mm above the table, within 72.5 mm horizontally of the mug's axis (mug radius + 30 mm, at any height); or the knife falling faster than 0.8 m/s. Permanent zero (any moment, cannot be undone): mug tilted more than 8 degrees or moved more than 15 mm (coffee spilt); knife off the table. Every threshold is a development estimate pending calibration. The trial ends at the run limit or once 1.00 has held for 1 s.
fidelity: Rigid bodies only. Paper towels are rigid thin plates (no bending or crumpling); coffee is not simulated and spilling is proxied by the mug's tilt and displacement; the apple is a sphere because library models can only rest on the table, not on the towels. Which arm handles which object, and where the knife is held, are not scored.
scores: TODO after GPU runs (scripted demo, Dream-1)
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. The pad and sheet must be laid back exactly over the knife.
